title: Pattern matching and functional C# techniques
summary: Learn how C# pattern matching replaces nested if chains with expressive, compiler-checked branches. This module covers expression-bodied members, switch expressions, pattern kinds, immutable record updates with with, and a real-world auth-provider branching scenario with Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI) and OpenID Connect (OIDC).

topics.title: Expression-bodied members (=> for methods and properties)
Switch expressions (pattern-matching switch that returns a value)
Pattern kinds (declaration, property, relational, list, and logical patterns)
with expressions and immutability (non-destructive record updates)
Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI) and auth-provider branching
